depth_m.note: This 2018 review's Table I gives CJPL-II the SAME 2,400 m depth column as CJPL-I, as the site:cjpl-ii record now does (an earlier 2100 m was not supported by its cited 2014 paper, arXiv:1404.2651).

geometry.locator: Table III: "Main Road Tunnels ... 9.2(8.3) km from East(West) Entrance"; Section VI: "CJPL-II is located 500 m to the west of CJPL-I"
geometry.note: Point stands in for the four-cavern hall complex's centre; not a trace of the individual caverns' footprints (their exact offsets from this reference point along the connecting tunnels were not fetched to a level that supports drawing polygons).
geometry.quote: CJPL-II is located 500 m to the west of CJPL-I, along the same road tunnel. It will have four caverns, each with dimensions of 14 m (width) x 14 m (height) x 130 m (length)

method: Walked along the Jinping traffic tunnel (OSM ways 681216327 and 653641019, the twin bores) from both portals, using the distances CJPL's own review paper states for CJPL-II: 8.3 km from the west portal and 9.2 km from the east portal (Table III). This gives four independent point estimates (2 bores x 2 directions of measurement); they agree to within 5-41 m of their centroid (mean pairwise spread ~39 m), which is used here as the coordinate. This is anchored entirely on the OSM tunnel line (accuracy 25 m) and the paper's own portal distances, not on any earlier site-level campus point, so it does not rest on a coarser anchor than its own stated accuracy. The tunnel-derived point sits 622 m from the campus-grade geocoder point already on record for this site (well inside that point's own precision of 2500 m): consistent, not a contradiction. It is internally consistent with the CJPL-I point: the two tunnel-derived positions are exactly 500.0 m apart, matching the sourced 'CJPL-II is 500 m west of CJPL-I' statement by construction (the two portal-distance pairs, 8.8/8.7 km and 8.3/9.2 km, differ by exactly 0.5 km), so that agreement is not treated as an independent check.
name: CJPL-II experimental halls (derived point, walked along the traffic tunnel)

summary.plain: CJPL-II's four-cavern experimental hall complex, located by walking the sourced portal distances along the OpenStreetMap trace of the Jinping traffic tunnel, 500 m from CJPL-I.
